summary: Məštamaʕle denotes assembling with ʕam-marked associates and no transitive patient. Its L-series Preterit shape does not make the semantic event transitive.
The inherited Arabic VIII etymology and glossary I allocation are retained; donor-language stem numbering does not prescribe the Turoyo glossary label.

Only the already cited 56/30 event is supplied. A longer council speech does not improve the short, independently intelligible existing example enough to justify duplication. The delta therefore has no stem changes.
